agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Action 10 let 18-HP Croakatoa commit Vacuum Wave into faster Shock Wave and faint without dealing damage; switching to full-HP Bushtank preserved Croakatoa and entered the intended Eelektrik matchup at 51/57 HP.

resolution.observed: One bounded cartridge replay verified Bushtank took only 6 Shock Wave damage; hybrid-policy-v16 now selects that switch with a positive two-hit survival margin.

findings.summary: The verifier called action 10 executed because Vacuum Wave PP fell, although battle text and HP proved Croakatoa fainted before the move took effect.

resolution.observed: battle-step-v5 replays the same state/action as interrupted_before_execution while retaining the real PP decrement and no discrepancies.

findings.summary: Action 19 spent 13-HP Ohmnomnom on Nuzzle into Sunflora instead of pivoting to the preserved Grass-resistant Bugatti.

resolution.observed: One bounded replay verified Bugatti survived Energy Ball at 30/41 HP; the corrected type evidence now makes the policy select Bugatti and preserve Ohmnomnom.

findings.summary: Lildozer fainted after its second burned Bulldoze, but it acted twice, reduced Ponyta to its Sitrus line, and every available switch was exposed to a possible critical KO; no verified alternative dominated.

Bushtank attempted a fourth Razor Leaf at 2 HP and fainted before acting; at that recorded state every replacement still failed the conservative entry bound, so this was not proven avoidable, while the earlier Croakatoa pivot fix should prevent reaching the same state.

Seeded Bugatti missed its locked Rollout sequence and fainted to Infestation plus Venoshock. A bounded immediate Birdlaw pivot fell to 15 HP after one Aerial Ace with Dustox still outside guaranteed KO range, so it did not dominate the winning line.
The branch needed 28 decisions, four more than corrected Clone 1; the two resolved pivots should reduce forced replacements and late cleanup.

correct_choices: The only voluntary switch was Ohmnomnom to Lildozer, and Lildozer attacked twice; no Pokémon switched in and immediately switched back out.
Croakatoa used fresh-entry Fake Out once, then two Mud Shots, without Fake Out spam.
Bushtank was reserved for Eelektrik and dealt three verified Razor Leaf hits before its terminal attempt.
Bugatti used two Bug Bites to remove Sunflora and Birdlaw completed Dustox with three Aerial Aces.
The cartridge terminal state authoritatively verified victory with Birdlaw at 32 HP.
agent_review.next_test: Restart qualification at Clone 1 with behavior hash db3909fe2d25ab5dc0263b9e30dab28df2505d937e5486298f90867721d46ff7; verify the purposeful Croakatoa-to-Bushtank and Ohmnomnom-to-Bugatti pivots, no switch reversal, and improved survivor count.
